overview: The City Council convened its first preliminary budget hearing for fiscal year 2027 to review the Treasurer-Collector, Finance and Procurement, and Information Technology budgets. No formal decisions were made as the budget items were referred back to committee for further review.

items.title: Opening of Annual Budget Process (Item 26-061)
items.summary: The council called to order the first of several preliminary budget meetings scheduled through mid-May to review departmental recommendations for the fiscal 2027 budget cycle.

items.title: Treasurer-Collector Budget Review
items.summary: Treasurer-Collector Judy Johnston detailed a budget increase driven by contractual salary step raises, a shift to a part-time clerk position, and an additional $7,000 for postage costs.

items.title: Finance and Procurement Budget Review
items.summary: Director Bob Dickinson discussed contractual increases and ongoing efforts to resolve legacy grant deficits in the city’s accounting system. The department highlighted challenges with staff retention due to state agencies offering higher pay and remote work flexibility.

items.title: Information Technology Budget Review
items.summary: Director Rich Lane presented an IT budget that absorbs approximately $165,000 for cybersecurity and software licensing previously funded by federal ARPA grants. The department also updated the council on citywide fiber installation and the transition to new network infrastructure at City Hall.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Adjournment
items.summary: The Chief of Staff noted ongoing work to close the current budget gap and find additional funding for the school department before the meeting adjourned.
